What you get

How it works

Three steps.

  1. Upload resumes

    Up to 10 at once — PDF, Word (.docx), Pages or TXT.

  2. Paste the job description

    The more detail you include, the better the matching.

  3. Read the ranked results

    Start at the top and download or email the full report.

ⓘ A screening aid, not the decision. Use the ranking to decide who to read first, and make the hiring decision yourself.

FAQ

Common questions.

How many resumes can I screen at once?
Up to 10 per batch. Run another batch for more.
Is this the same as the ATS Analyzer in Workblox Personal?
No. The Personal ATS Analyzer helps a job seeker improve one resume. This tool helps an employer compare several candidates against a full job description.
Are the resumes stored?
No. Resumes are processed to produce your results and nothing is kept afterward. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Batch ATS Analyzer is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
